questions.prompt: Which of the following commands show how the shell handles a specific command?
questions.explanation: El comando interno de Bash type indica cómo interpretaría la shell un nombre de comando si se ejecutara: si es un alias, una palabra reservada ( keyword ), una función, un comando interno ( builtin ) o un archivo ejecutable en disco.

questions.prompt: Given a log file loga.log with timestamps of the format DD/MM/YYYY:hh:mm:ss, which command filters out all log entries in the time period between 8:00 am and 8:59 am?
questions.explanation: La opción -E activa expresiones regulares extendidas (necesarias para el cuantificador + , que significa "uno o más dígitos"). El patrón :08:[0-9]+:[0-9]+ busca la hora 08 seguida de cualquier minuto y segundo entre 08:00:00 y 08:59:59 , seguido del nombre del archivo loga.log .

questions.prompt: Which file defines the network locations from where the Debian package manager downloads software packages?
questions.explanation: En sistemas basados en Debian, APT lee la lista de repositorios de red desde /etc/apt/sources.list (y archivos adicionales en /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ ), según man 5 sources.list .

questions.prompt: What option to useradd creates a new user's home directory and provisions it with a set of standard files? (Specify only the option name without any values or parameters.).
questions.explanation: La opción -m (o --create-home ) de useradd fuerza la creación del directorio personal del usuario y copia dentro de él los archivos base contenidos en /etc/skel .

questions.prompt: What is the process ID number of the init process on a System V init based system?

options.text: It is set to the current run level

questions.explanation: El proceso init es el primer proceso de espacio de usuario ejecutado por el kernel tras el arranque y el padre directo o indirecto de todos los demás procesos; el kernel le asigna siempre el PID 1 ( man 8 init ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following is true about IPv6?

options.text: IPv6 no longer supports broadcast addresses.
With IPv6, the TCP port numbers of most services have changed.
IPv4 addresses can be used without any change with IPv6.
IPv6 no longer supports multicast addresses.
For I Pv6, UDP and TCP have been replaced by the Rapid Transmission Protocol RTP.

options.text: When configured correctly ~/.forward can be used to forward each incoming mail to one or more other recipients.
After editing ~/.forward the user must run newaliases to make the mail server aware of the changes.
Using ~/.forward, root may configure any email address whereas all other users may configure only their own addre sses.

questions.prompt: What is the maximum niceness value that a regular user can assign to a process with the nice command when executing a new process?
questions.explanation: Los valores de niceness en Linux van desde -20 (máxima prioridad de planificación) hasta 19 (mínima prioridad de planificación). Los usuarios normales solo pueden disminuir la prioridad de sus procesos asignando valores positivos hasta el máximo de 19 ( man 1 nice ).

questions.prompt: What is the top-level directory which contains the configuration files for CUPS? (Specify the full path to the directory.).
questions.explanation: El sistema de impresión común de Unix (CUPS) almacena todos sus archivos de configuración principales ( cupsd.conf , printers.conf , classes.conf , etc.) bajo el directorio /etc/cups .

questions.prompt: In the vi editor, how can commands such as moving the cursor or copying lines into the buffer be issued multiple times or applied to multiple rows?

options.text: By using the command :repeat followed by the number and the command.
By specifying the number right in front of a command such as 41 or 2yj.
By selecting all affected lines using the shit and cursor keys before applying the command.
By is suing a command such as :set repetition=4 with repeats every subsequent command 4 times.
By specifying the number after a command such as 14 or yj2 followed by escape.

questions.explanation: En vi , cualquier comando de movimiento o edición en modonormal puede repetirse N N N veces escribiendo el número justo delante del comando (por ejemplo, 4l para avanzar 4 caracteres o 2yj para copiar la línea actual y las siguientes hacia abajo).

questions.prompt: When removing a package on a system using dpkg package management, which dpkg option ensures configuration files are removed as well?
questions.explanation: En dpkg ( man 1 dpkg ), la opción --purge (o -P ) elimina por completo un paquete instalado, incluyendo todos sus archivos de configuración.

questions.prompt: Which file, if present, must contain all users that are allowed to use the cron scheduling system? (Specify the full name of the file, including path.).
questions.explanation: Si el archivo /etc/cron.allow existe en el sistema, solo los usuarios listados explícitamente dentro de él tienen permiso para usar crontab (ignorando /etc/cron.deny ).

questions.prompt: What is true regarding public and private SSH keys? (Choose two.).

options.text: For each user account, there is exactly one key pair that can be used to log into that account.
The private key must never be revealed to anyone.
Several different public keys may be generated for the same private key.
To maintain the private key's confidentiality, the SSH key pair must be created by its owner.
To allow remote logins, the user's private key mus t be copied to the remote serv er.

questions.prompt: Which of the following partition types is used for Linux swap spaces when partitioning hard disk drives?

questions.prompt: How do shadow passwords improve the password security in comparison to standard no-shadow password?

options.text: Regular users do not have access to the password hashes of shadow passwords.
Every shadow password is valid for 45 days and must be changed afterwards.
The system's host key is used to encrypt all shadow passwords.
Shadow passwords are always combined with a public key that has to match the user's p rivate key.
Shadow passwords are stored in plain text and can be checked for weak passwords.

questions.prompt: Which is the default percentage of reserved space for the root user on new ext4 filesystems?
questions.explanation: De acuerdo con la documentación de mke2fs ( man 8 mke2fs , opción -m reserved-blocks-percentage ), el porcentaje de bloques del sistema de archivos reservado por defecto para el superusuario ( root ) es del 5% . Esto evita que el sistema colapse si los usuarios llenan el disco y reduce la fragmentación.

questions.prompt: Which command included in NetworkManager is a curses application which provides easy acces to the NetworkManager on the command line? (Specify only the command without any path or parameters.).
questions.explanation: nmtui ( NetworkManager Text User Interface ) proporciona una interfaz interactiva basada en curses en la terminal para gestionar conexiones de NetworkManager.

questions.prompt: Which of the following regular expressions represents a single upper-case letter?
questions.explanation: En expresiones regulares, los corchetes [] definen una clase de caracteres que coincide con un único carácter contenido en el rango especificado. [A-Z] coincide con cualquier letra mayúscula individual de la A a la Z. (La clase POSIX :upper: requeriría doble corchete [[:upper:]] ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements are correct when comparing Linux containers with traditional virtual machines (e.g. LXC vs. KVM)? (Choose three.)

options.text: Containers are a lightweight virtualization method where the kernel controls process isolation and resource management.
Fully v irtualized machines can run any operating system for a specific hardware architecture within the virtua l machine.
Containers are completely decoupled from the host system's physical hardware and can only use emulate d virtual hardware devices.
The guest environment for fully virtualized machines is created by a hypervisor which provides virtual and emulated hardware devices.
Containers on the same host can use different operating systems, as the container hypervisor creates separate kernel execution.

questions.explanation: Los contenedores comparten el mismo kernel del sistema anfitrión y utilizan mecanismos del kernel ( namespaces y cgroups ) para aislar procesos y gestionar recursos. En cambio, las máquinas virtuales completas utilizan un hipervisor (como KVM/QEMU) que emula hardware y permite ejecutar cualquier sistema operativo con su propio kernel independiente.

questions.prompt: Which of the following commands list all files and directories within the /tmp/ directory and its subdirectories which are owned by the user root? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: En find ( man 1 find ), el primer argumento posicional es la ruta de búsqueda ( /tmp ), seguido del predicado -user root (que busca por nombre de propietario; -uid requeriría un número entero como 0 ). La acción por defecto si no se especifica ninguna es -print , por lo que poner -print explícitamente ono ponerlo produce exactamente el mismo resultado válido.

questions.prompt: What is the effect of the -v option for the grep command?

options.text: I t enables color to highlight matching parts.
It shows the command's version information.
It changes the output order showing the last matching line first.
It outputs all lines and prefixes matching lines with a+.

questions.explanation: De acuerdo con man 1 grep , la opción -v (o --invert-match ) invierte el sentido de la búsqueda, seleccionando e imprimiendo únicamente las líneas que no coinciden con el patrón especificado.

questions.prompt: If neither cron.allow nor cron.deny exist in /etc/, which of the following is true?

options.text: Without additional configuration, all users may create user specific crontabs.
Without additional configuration, only root may create user specific crontabs.
The cron daemon will refuse to start and report missing files in the system's logfile.
When a user creates a user specific crontab the system administrator must approve it explicit ly.
The default settings of /etc/crond.conf define whether or not user specific crontabs are generally allowed or not.

questions.prompt: On a Linux workstation, the route command takes a long time before printing out the routing table. Which of the following errors does that indicate?

options.text: The local routing information may be corrupted and must be re-validated using a routing protocol.
One of the routers in the routing table is not available which causes the automatic router failure detection mechanism (ARF-D) to wait for a timeout.
There may accidentally be more than one default router in which case a default router election has to be done on the n etwork in order to choose one router as the default.
The Linux Kernel Routing Daemon (LKRD) is not running and should be started using its init script or systemd unit.
DNS resolution may not be worki ng as route by default tries to resolve names of routers and destinations and may run into a timeout.

questions.prompt: In Bash, inserting 1>&2 after a command redirects…
questions.explanation: En los descriptores de archivos estándar POSIX, 0 es entrada estándar ( stdin ), 1 es salida estándar ( stdout ) y 2 es error estándar ( stderr ). Por tanto, 1>&2 redirige la salida estándar ( 1 ) hacia el error estándar ( 2 ).

questions.explanation: En Linux, los discos SCSI/SATA se nombran secuencialmente: /dev/sda (primero), /dev/sdb (segundo) y /dev/sdc (tercero). El comando para instalar el cargador de arranque GRUB en el MBR del disco es grub-install /dev/sdc ( man 8 grub-install ).

questions.prompt: Which of the following situations is observed and corrected by an NTP client?

options.text: The skew in time between the system clock and the computer's hardware clock.
The physical location and the time zone configuration.
Changes in the time zone of the current computer's location.
Adjustment needed to support Dayligh t Saving Time.
The skew in time between the system clock and the reference clock.

questions.prompt: When booting from the hard disk, a computer successfully loads the Linux kernel and initramfs but hangs during th e subsequent startup tasks. The system is booted using a Linux based rescue CD to investigate the problem. Which of the following methods helps to identify the root cause of the problem?

options.text: Using the dmesg command from the rescue CD's shell to view the original system's boot logs.
Investigating the file /proc/kmsg on the computer's hard disk for possible errors.
Investigating the file /var/log on the computer's hard disk for possible errors.
Using chroot to switch to the file system on the har d disk and use dmesg to view the logs.
Rebooting again from the hard drive since the system successfully booted from the rescue CD.

questions.explanation: dmesg y /proc/kmsg muestran únicamente los mensajes en memoria del kernel actualmente en ejecución (es decir, el del CD de rescate, incluso si se hace chroot ). Como el sistema original ya había superado la fase de initramfs y estaba ejecutando las tareas de inicio sobre el disco duro, los registros persistentes de dicho arranque fallido quedaron guardados en el directorio /var/log del disco duro.

questions.prompt: Which of the following changes may occur as a consequence of using the command ip? (Choose three.).

options.text: Network interfaces may become active or inactive.
New name servers may be added to the resolver configuration.
The system's host name may change.
The routing table may chan ge.

questions.prompt: When considering the use of hard links, what are valid reasons not to use hard links?

options.text: Hard links are not available on all Linux systems because traditional filesystems, such as ext4, donot support them.
Each hard link has individual ownership, permissions and ACLs which can lead to unintended disclosure of file conten t.
Hard links are specific to one filesystem and cannot point to files on another filesystem.
If users other than root should be able to create hard links, suln has to be installed and configured.
When a h ard linked file is changed, a copy of the file is created and consumes additional space.

questions.explanation: Un enlace duro ( hard link ) es una entrada de directorio que apunta directamente a un número de inodo. Dado que cada sistema de archivos gestiona su propia tabla de inodos de forma independiente, es imposible que un enlace duro cruce límites entre distintas particiones o sistemas de archivos ( man 1 ln ).

questions.prompt: When booting from the hard disk, a computer successfully loads the Linux kernel and initramfs but hangs during th e subsequent startup tasks. Investigating the file /proc/kmsg on the computer's hard disk for possible errors.
Investigating the file /var/log on the computer's hard disk for possible errors.
Using chroot to switch to the file system on the har d disk and use dmesg to view the logs.
Rebooting again from the hard drive since the system successfully booted from the rescue CD.
